fig1_dispersion.svg: The two longitudinal branches vs $k\lambda_D$, each normalised to its own scale (curves from bohm_gross / ion_acoustic). Langmuir starts at the $\omega_p$ cutoff and stiffens via the Bohm$-$Gross pressure term $3k^2v_{th}^2$; ion-acoustic is gapless sound $\omega\simeq kc_s$ that bends over and saturates at the ion plasma frequency $\omega_{pi}=c_s/\lambda_D$.
fig2_two_stream.svg: Growth rate of the cold two-stream instability (counter-streaming beams at $\pm v_0$): dots are two_stream_growth_rate, which solves the bi-quadratic $\varepsilon(k,\omega)=0$ with numpy.roots, on the closed-form curve. $\mathrm{Im}\,\omega>0$ only in the band $kv_0<\omega_p$, peaking at $\gamma_{\max}=\omega_p/\sqrt8$ at $kv_0=\sqrt{3/8}\,\omega_p$ — the opposite-sign cousin of Landau damping, fed by the beams' free energy.
